findings.quote: After LC/MS indicated no reaction had taken place at room temp, the temperature was gradually rasied to up to 110 degrees. LC/MS indicated that the reaction was not progressing.
findings.message: The plan omits both LC/MS checks: one at room temperature before heating and one after heating. These should be retained as unmapped actions because the allowed operations do not represent analytical monitoring. No sampling procedure should be inferred.

value.evidence: After LC/MS indicated no reaction had taken place at room temp
value.reason: LC/MS monitoring at room temperature before heating is not represented by an allowed operation; sampling details and elapsed time are unspecified.

value.evidence: LC/MS indicated that the reaction was not progressing.
value.reason: LC/MS monitoring reported after heating is not represented by an allowed operation; sampling details and elapsed time are unspecified.
